goal:
Scaffold React + Vite build pipeline for Zo Sentinel UI Phase 1.

Create zo_sentinel/ui_react/ with:

1. Vite + React + TypeScript setup
   - package.json with: react, react-dom, vite, typescript, tailwindcss, @shadcn/ui, lucide-react
   - tailwind.config.js with slate colour palette, DM Sans font
   - vite.config.ts: build output to dist/, proxy /api to http://127.0.0.1:8790

2. Core layout components (src/components/):
   - AppShell.tsx: collapsible left sidebar + topbar + main content area
   - Sidebar.tsx: nav items (Dashboard, Servers, Watchlist, Submissions, Health, Settings)
   - TopBar.tsx: logo, global search, user profile dropdown
   - VerdictBadge.tsx: colour-coded pill component
   - TrustScoreGauge.tsx: SVG ring 0-100 with verdict colour
   - ServerDataGrid.tsx: sortable/filterable/paginated table
   - SignalBreakdown.tsx: expandable signal score panel
   - EmptyState.tsx: icon + message + CTA for zero-data

3. Pages (src/pages/):
   - Dashboard.tsx: stats bar + watchlist + leaderboard
   - Servers.tsx: full data grid with filters
   - ServerDetail.tsx: single server drill-down
   - Submissions.tsx: MCP submission form + queue
   - Health.tsx: service health dashboard

4. API layer (src/api/zo-bridge.ts):
   Typed wrapper for all /api/* endpoints.
   Graceful error handling — never surface raw errors to UI.

5. ui_server.py integration:
   Add route: app.mount('/app', StaticFiles(directory='ui_react/dist'), name='ui_react')
   Redirect / to /app if dist/ exists.

6. Build script:
   Add build_ui.sh: cd ui_react && npm install && npm run build
   Add to zm go bootstrap: bash /home/workspace/zo_sentinel/build_ui.sh

Design system:
  Font: DM Sans (Google Fonts)
  Colours: slate-900 bg, slate-50 text, emerald-500 trusted, amber-500 amber, red-500 untrusted, gray-400 unknown
  No pure black (#000) or pure white (#fff)
constraints: Do not break existing ui_server.py routes
success_criteria: All 5 pages render without console errors
API calls work against live WriteService
